cohort: 745 patients aged 20-50 years undergoing elective cesarean sections with spinal anesthesia and American Society of Anesthesiologists II and III scores
finding: The incidence of PDPH was lower in patients who received spinal anesthesia with pencil-point needles compared to those who received atraumatic needles.
mod_finding: The study investigates the effect of spinal needle type on outcomes related to cesarean sections.
